answer: Continuous Presence Registry. Each identity must continuously answer environmental micro-challenges (light level, sound floor) read from a co-located sensor puck whose jade casing is physically sealed; the operator cannot compute answers ahead because the seed is re-sampled every few seconds from ambient noise. A yarrow-grown foraging check requires the puck's harvest log, tying enrollment to a meadow plot. Faking one identity means buying a puck, powering it, and physically maintaining a distinct location — roughly hardware plus labor cost per month.
